parameters.name: Marker
parameters.description: The marker. If the response is truncated, you can use `Marker` to retrieve the content that starts from the position after the truncation point.

parameters.name: MaxItems
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return. If the response is truncated because it reaches the `MaxItems` limit, the `IsTruncated` parameter is set to `true`.

Valid values: 1 to 1000. Default value: 100.
